name: hako
description: Otzar: quantum-safe Bitcoin vaults that earn, on NEAR (formerly Hako)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hako/sdk build && pnpm --filter @hako/mcp build && pnpm --filter @hako/web build && (cd packages/test-usdc && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm) && cd packages/contract && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm
scripts.test: pnpm build && cargo test --manifest-path packages/contract/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path packages/test-usdc/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter @hako/sdk test && pnpm --filter @hako/mcp test && pnpm --filter @hako/web test && scripts/test-sandbox.sh && scripts/test-calls-sandbox.sh && scripts/test-nbtc-sandbox.sh
